item.title: St. Clair county sheriff's office investigates child abuse report, arrests made
item.description: On December 16th, St. Clair County Deputies responded to a local medical clinic in reference to a child abuse. It was determined that the sores were from MRSA, and had gone untreated for over a year.The Detective applied for a warrant, and on January 13, 2026, a warrant came down from the St. Clair County Courthouse charging Keisha Morgan and William Robinson with Endangering the Welfare of a Child - 1st Degree - Physical Injury - No Sexual Contact and Abuse or Neglect of a Child Under Section 5

item.title: Missouri 4-H seeks families wishing to host exchange students
item.description: Bring the world home this summer! #MO4H is looking for families to host a Japanese youth (ages 12–18) or adult chaperone through our 4-H International Exchange Program from July 23–August 18, 2026. No special activities needed—just share your everyday life and build lifelong friendships. Learn more & apply today! https://www.states4hexchange.org/ #MO4H #ExtendMU

item.title: The Wall That Heals receives donation from Bates County Elks
item.description: Diana and Jason Bennett representing the Bates County Elks presented a donation for The Wall That Heals, a replica of the Vietnam Veteran in Washington DC that is set to be on display in Bates County beginning in late April 2026. Thank you!For more information on how to donate or volunteer with the project, contact Marsha Youngblood at 816-716-9217, John Gray at 816-547-4797 or Jami Page at 660-424-4215. The Bates county The Wall That Heals Facebook page can be found here https://www.facebook.co

item.title: Obituary - Melanie Morris
item.description: The world lost a rare and beautiful soul on January 12, 2026, when Melanie Morris left us at the age of 49.
